description: This file defines a command class for restoring the database to a specific savepoint within a functional testing context of the OrangeHRM system. It includes command configuration and execution logic, using the DatabaseBackupService to perform the restore operation.

classes.name: RestoreDatabaseToSavepointCommand
classes.description: A console command class that enables restoring an OrangeHRM test database to a specified savepoint during functional testing.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command with a description and required argument 'savepointName'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to restore the database to a specified savepoint and outputs a success message.
